正文可用中文或英文。说明触发条件、原有问题和改动后的行为；关联相关 issue。

## 验证

<!--
记录被测 commit、实际命令、结果及脱敏证据；区分 PASS / FAIL / SKIP / NOT_RUN / N/A。
说明跳过、未运行或不适用的原因；缺陷修复附修复前后的结果。
涉及硬件、镜像或模型时，附实际测试环境、镜像摘要及模型 revision。
Record the tested commit, commands, results, and redacted evidence using
PASS / FAIL / SKIP / NOT_RUN / N/A. Explain skipped, unrun, or inapplicable checks;
include before/after results for bug fixes. For hardware, image, or model changes,
include the tested environment, image digest, and model revision.
-->

## 说明

<!--
说明方案依据、兼容性影响和剩余工作；没有补充内容时写“无”。

Explain the approach, compatibility impact, and remaining work; write "None" if

Report vulnerabilities privately as described in SECURITY.md.
-->
